own_solution.law: Energy conservation gives Tf = (m1 T1 + m2 T2)/(m1 + m2); entropy generated S = c[m1 ln(Tf/T1) + m2 ln(Tf/T2)] (isolated system)
assumptions: negligible volume change, so dU = m c dT (stated)

notes: Base: Tf = 1590/5 = 318 K; S = 900[2 ln(318/360) + 3 ln(318/290)] = 900[-0.248105 + 0.276511] = 25.566 J/K. With hot mass 3.1 kg: Tf = 1986/6.1 = 325.574 K; S = 900[3.1 ln(0.904372) + 3 ln(1.122668)] = 900[-0.311596 + 0.347125] = 31.976 J/K. T8625 does not state when the metal is added, but 'added to the hotter block' at its temperature naturally means before contact. Mould sentences are D since no heat passes between mould and enclosure. T33C5 and TFF07 carry no number.
